//: PROVENANCE AS A BUILD INPUT — SA §TS-12.3/§TS-12.4, SD §FE-10, SD Revision Log D8, as departed from under EV-16 (extended by stakeholder ruling OE-5, 2026-10-11) and OE-81. One record per safety_critical key PER LOCALE. `content_hash` is `sha256:` + lowercase hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the catalogue source string after Unicode NFC normalisation; `contentHash()` in src/review.ts is the one implementation and gate:safety-review-currency calls it. SINCE OE-5 NO HUMAN REVIEWS THIS COPY: every record is `ai_authored` (the model named in `authored_by`, the authorship ruling cited in `ruling` — OE-66 for el/ru, OE-67 for en), `status: "unreviewed_by_ruling"` with `review_ruling: "OE-5"`, and `reviewed_by`/`reviewed_at` null. That status means FINAL WITH NO REVIEW, by stakeholder ruling; it does not mean a review is pending. The gate's rule (T-258, T-259): for every safety_critical key and every enabled locale, FAIL unless the record exists; its hash matches the current source AND the hash pinned in the gate's own AUTHORED_CONTENT_PINNED; it is `ai_authored` under a ruling in tools/rulings.ts with that ruling's exact model as `authored_by`; it is `unreviewed_by_ruling` under OE-5; its `status` is not `signed_off` and no field whose name contains "review" other than `review_ruling` is non-null; it carries no field outside the nine a record defines; and its `note`, if present, is a string or null. The rulings are written in tools/rulings.ts, not here: a register that could grant its own authority would be measuring itself. Editing a safety string fails the gate until the same commit edits the record's hash and the gate's pin, which makes the edit visible in review of the diff; nothing here proves which model wrote the bytes. `pending_pipeline` is null: the dated waiver waited for a human review that OE-5 ruled out (T-259).

pipeline.//: THE PIPELINE AS DATA — T-049, SA §TS-12.4, as departed from under EV-16. Since stakeholder ruling OE-5 (2026-10-11; EV-16 extended) no human authors or reviews this copy: OE-66/OE-67 made an AI model its author and OE-5 dropped the DSL + deputy review. NO DATE IS IN FORCE HERE (T-259). NO PERSON AND NO HUMAN STEP IS RECORDED HERE: T-260 deleted the roster of human roles (`roles`), the steps they would complete (`stages`) and the per-locale authoring method (`assignments[*].locales`), and src/review.ts's pipelineIncoherences() refuses any of them coming back, run over this file by src/pipeline.test.ts in gate:unit-tests. The 360 px in-context check and the read-aloud check are automated gates under OE-82 (`automated_checks` below); since T-264 gate:safety-review-currency refuses a record at the terminal status whose check is absent, stale or failed. `assignments` carries, per safety_critical key, the emergency-panel flag, the channel and the machine- and runtime-translation bans, and nothing else.

automated_checks.what: SA §TS-12.4's read-aloud check, made by a gate under OE-82: every spoken safety string, in every enabled locale and every plural form, is synthesised with espeak-ng and checked for speakable tokens, sentence length and duration; the record binds each pair's content_hash. Which keys it applies to is pinned in tools/automated-checks.ts (READ_ALOUD_KEYS_PINNED), not here. Nothing it synthesises ships (DV-7).

SA §TS-12.4's in-context check, made by a gate under OE-82: every shown safety string is rendered in the running product at a pinned 360 px Android viewport in every enabled locale, and refused if it is not visible, differs from the catalogue, clips, truncates, overflows or is a tap target under 44x44. Which keys it applies to is pinned in tools/automated-checks.ts (RENDER_KEYS_PINNED); a key whose surface does not exist yet is listed in AWAITING_SURFACE against the ticket that builds it, and that list must be empty for production readiness.

session.checkins_missed.channel_note: UNDETERMINED, and fail-closed on purpose. This is an escalation-ladder message, and DV-7 adds an automated VOICE rung with pre-recorded audio per locale (SA §INT-5r). Whether this key is rendered on that rung is T-105/T-107’s determination, not this ticket’s. Until it is decided, the key is held to both automated checks: READ_ALOUD_KEYS_PINNED and RENDER_KEYS_PINNED in tools/automated-checks.ts pin it as undetermined (a channel change that does not move both pins is refused as CHANNEL-DRIFT), gate:read-aloud checks it in every locale, and its 360 px render check awaits its surface (AWAITING_SURFACE, T-107).
